thread:
priya: Hey infra/runtime/platform/security — pinging you all for PR #49288. It's a small but sensitive change to the eviction/orchestration flow: adds a cooldown window + moves the eviction header to a new config path. Need approvals and a merge window tomorrow 11:00am PST. Diffs: https://git.redwood/rdw/infra/pull/49288

sam: quick q — any perf regression expected at steady state? I can run a microbench if you have numbers.

priya: good call. ran a short perf run locally: `evictions/sim` median p99 tokens per second -2% but p50 unchanged. churn reduced in high-concurrency sim. TL;DR: slightly higher tail under pathological load but much lower overall eviction frequency.

linda: from platform side we need the rollout plan / canary config. can't do global merge without a staged rollout. Can you paste suggested canary steps?

priya: proposed plan:
```
- deploy canary to edge pool 'canary-a' at 5% traffic for 30m
- promote to 50% for 1h if no regressions, then 100% after validation
- rollback hook: set eviction.cooldown_ms = previous value via runtime flag and redeploy
```

priya: also note there's a tiny API change: `EvictionHeader` moves from `orch.v1` to `orch.v2`. Platform needs to reconcile routing/compat.

tom: infra-eyes: I checked the yaml patch, nothing touches k8s RBAC or new ports. just a configmap key rename. I left an inline comment about the configmap key fallback.

ed: security — @priya can you confirm no new secrets, no new external endpoints, and that the new config doesn't relax auth checks? Also need to see a quick threat surface summary.

priya: confirmed: no secrets, no ports, auth checks unchanged. threat summary: the change only changes eviction timing and header namespace. I added unit tests for header parsing and a migration path.

devops-bot: CI: build passed \u2705, unit tests passed \u2705, integration tests running (ETA ~10m)

sam: I can sign off runtime after a brief perf sanity run on canary infra. Will need 2-3 hours to run the job and check traces (kv-cache, eviction traces). If infra/platform schedule canary start at 11:00am PST, I can validate by 14:00 PST.

linda: 11:00am PST works for platform canary kickoff. I'll own the rollout steps and gating dashboards. Please add the canary dashboard link to the PR when ready.

ed: security +1 pending the integration test output and the threat summary doc in the PR.

jess: infra quick lgtm for config rename, nothing risky here from infra side.

priya: thanks all. action items I will: (1) attach perf run logs and traces to the PR, (2) add the canary dashboard + rollout checklist, (3) address tom's configmap fallback comment.

priya: final request — can runtime (sam) and security (ed) do async sign-off on the PR once CI integration finishes? hoping to merge after both + platform canary entry. :thumbsup:

sam: yup i'll drop a comment with the perf summary and sign off if looks ok.

devops-bot: integration tests: all green \u2705 (timestamp 1777777825)

ed: security: integration green, threat summary ok, marking sign-off.

sam: runtime: perf run on canary infra looks good (p50 unchanged, p99 +1.5%). sign-off.

priya: awesome — thanks everyone. merging after the 11:00 canary kickoff and platform gating. will post final follow-up here with rollout links.

jess: :rocket: good luck canary!
